entry.title: Goldman's Kaplan on Fed's Warsh and AI Capex Boom

Speaking on "Bloomberg Open Interest," Kaplan also says he sees an "historic" capital expenditures boom in the US. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: JPMorgan’s David Kelly Says AI Boom Will Refuel Stock Rally
entry.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co.’s asset-management arm is urging investors to stick with stocks and other higher-risk assets in the second half of 2026, arguing that an AI investment boom and resilient consumers should keep the expansion intact despite persistent inflation and a Federal Reserve on hold.

entry.title: SoftBank Scales Back Latin America Tech Bets as Venture Capital Boom Fades
